task.title: Port the brief and the board data
task.description:
## Why
These produce what the user reads: the written brief and the data the trade board draws.

## Steps
1. Port `rebuild/report.py`: `call_text`, `lineage_table` and `write`, which builds the brief as markdown.
2. Port `board_data`, `price_signals` and `deal_json` from `rebuild/board.py`.
3. Do not port `board.render`. The board will load its data over HTTP instead of having it baked into the page.
4. Do not port `rebuild/pdf.py`. Printing from the browser replaces it.

## Done when
- The port's board data and brief match the recorded `board-data.json` and `brief.md` for every fixture.
